name: Army Gals
source:
Army Gals is an adult visual novel set at a retreat for delinquents. The protagonist is forced to attend after a misunderstanding back at home. Expecting a fortnight of hell, he is pleasantly surprised to find he is sharing the retreat with three beautiful but very different young women.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dharkerstudio/army-gals/description]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
《Army Gals》是一部成人视觉小说，背景设定在罪犯避难所。主角因家里的误会而被迫参加。原本期待着两周的地狱般的经历，他惊喜地发现自己正在与三位美丽但截然不同的年轻女子共享静修处。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dharkerstudio/army-gals/description]Kickstarter活动[/url]]
